briefdescription.para: Prometheus metrics exporter for prompt engineering system.

detaileddescription.para:
Exposes metrics in Prometheus text format for:
Optimization operations
A/B testing
Performance tracking
Feedback collection
Version control operations
Supports snapshot/restore for crash-safe persistence and threshold-based alerting via pluggable callbacks.
